16-bit frame: dark skies and shadows don: Bingkai 16-bit: langit dan bayang gelap tidak berjalur. Sedikit lebih VRAM. Permulaan seterusnya.

A DualSense's light changes with the dim: Cahaya DualSense berubah mengikut dimensi anda.

A DualSense's triggers push back on bows: Pencetus DualSense menolak balik pada busur dan alat.

Animates water, lava, fire and other mov: Animates water, lava, fire and other moving textures.

Brighter-than-white output on an HDR dis: Brighter-than-white output on an HDR display.
CPU occlusion test runs this frame.

Tidak menunjukkan apa yang butang anda lakukan.
Draws ice in the solid pass, without its: Melukis ais dalam laluan pepejal, tanpa tekstur tembus pandangnya.
Draws the sky, sun, moon and stars.
Drops faces between leaves: faster, but: Drops faces between leaves: faster, but gaps look through.
Drops leaf faces behind two leaf layers:: Membuang muka daun di sebalik dua lapisan daun: lebih pantas, silara yang sama.
Efficient sleeps until the next frame; P: Efficient sleeps until the next frame; Precise spins, like vanilla.
Setiap tindakan kembali ke butang lalainya.
Every leaf face. Vanilla's fancy leaves.
F2 screenshots at this many times the ga: F2 screenshots at this many times the game's resolution. Higher takes longer.
Follow the controller, or always show on: Ikut pengawal, atau sentiasa tunjukkan butang satu keluarga.
Frame rate and frame times over the game: Frame rate and frame times over the game, with a graph.
Full-detail terrain range. LOD Distance: Full-detail terrain range. LOD Distance can extend local worlds farther.
Fullscreen takes the display over, at th: Skrin penuh mengambil alih paparan, pada mod di bawah.
Hold the button to sneak, or press it on: Tahan butang untuk menyelinap, atau tekan sekali untuk mula dan sekali lagi untuk berhenti.
How bright highlights get. Auto: the pea: How bright highlights get. Auto: the peak your system reports.
How bright white looks in the world. Aut: Betapa cerahnya putih kelihatan di dunia. Auto: putih desktop anda.
How far Anisotropic filtering goes. High: Sejauh mana penapisan Anisotropik pergi. Lebih tinggi lebih tajam pada sudut serong.
How far a trigger is pulled before it co: Sejauh mana pencetus ditarik sebelum ia dikira ditekan.
How far around you BlueMap tiles are dow: How far around you BlueMap tiles are downloaded. Next join.
How far away mobs and items are drawn, a: How far away mobs and items are drawn, as a share of normal.
How far clouds reach, in chunks.
How far mobs, crops and machines keep wo: How far mobs, crops and machines keep working. CPU time.
How far rain and snow fall around you.

How far the right stick moves before the: Sejauh mana kayu kanan bergerak sebelum pandangan berpusing. Naikkannya jika pandangan hanyut.
How far you see, the window and the HUD.
Betapa pantas kayu kanan menatal senarai.
Betapa pantas kayu kanan memusing pandangan.

Sedang digunakan: tekan untuk mematikan shader.
Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from: Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from fading far away.
Lava, fire and sunlight shine brighter t: Lava, fire and sunlight shine brighter than white. Needs an HDR display.
Leaves fully inside a canopy draw solid:: Leaves fully inside a canopy draw solid: fewer see-through layers.
Leaves with one open side draw solid too: Leaves with one open side draw solid too: faster, chunkier edges.
Leaves with see-through gaps. Off draws: Leaves with see-through gaps. Off draws them solid.
Lets LT + A craft on servers other than: Membolehkan LT + A mengkraf pada pelayan selain dunia anda sendiri. Sesetengah pelayan mengiranya sebagai makro.
Lifts shadows onto your display's darkes: Menaikkan bayang ke hitam paling gelap paparan anda. 0: hitam sebenar, tiada naikan.
Light sources, the sun and sunlight shin: Sumber cahaya, matahari dan cahaya matahari bersinar melebihi putih. Mati: sama seperti SDR.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Lower it until the logo just disappears into the black.
Lowers the frame rate when minimised, or: Menurunkan frame rate apabila ditutup, atau idle.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Make the card a white that's comfortable to look at for a long time, in the light you play in.
Mesh data sent to the GPU per frame. Low: Mesh data sent to the GPU per frame. Lower is smoother while loading.
Meshed sections uploaded per frame. Lowe: Meshed sections uploaded per frame. Lower is smoother while loading.
No shader packs yet: open the pack folde: Belum ada pek shader: buka folder pek dan letakkan beberapa di dalamnya.
Not bound: press this row, then the butt: Tidak terikat: tekan baris ini, kemudian butang yang sepatutnya melakukannya.
Not on DirectX 12 yet: try the Vulkan gr: Belum pada DirectX 12: cuba API grafik Vulkan.

Occlusion checks run on a worker thread.
Off, the game ignores every controller f: Mati, permainan mengabaikan setiap pengawal untuk pemain ini.
On servers, finds their BlueMap web map: On servers, finds their BlueMap web map for far terrain. Next join.
Only applies to asynchronous entity cull: Hanya terpakai pada pemotongan entiti tak segerak.
Opens Steam's keyboard on a Steam Deck u: Membuka papan kekunci Steam pada Steam Deck di bawah Steam, dan papan kekunci Horizon jika tidak.

Press this row, then the button that sho: Tekan baris ini, kemudian butang yang sepatutnya melakukannya.
Put shader pack .zip files or folders in: Letakkan fail .zip atau folder pek shader di dalamnya.
Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White back to your display's setup.
Puts every option of this pack back to i: Mengembalikan setiap pilihan pek ini kepada nilai lalai.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Raise it until the logo just disappears into the bright square.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for G: Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for GPUs it slows down.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser: faste: Reduced draws far terrain coarser: faster on this integrated GPU.

Reuses closed chests; moving lids stay a: Reuses closed chests; moving lids stay animated.
Reuses poles; flags and pattern layers s: Reuses poles; flags and pattern layers still update.
Reuses settled boxes; lid movement stays: Reuses settled boxes; lid movement stays animated.
Reuses sign text until text, light, or f: Reuses sign text until text, light, or font changes.
Reuses statue geometry until its block s: Reuses statue geometry until its block state changes.
Reuses still bells; ringing stays animat: Reuses still bells; ringing stays animated.
Reuses still pots; break wobble and sher: Reuses still pots; break wobble and sherd changes redraw.
Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, vie: Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, view and world match. Off by default.
Round shadows under mobs and items.
Getar apabila sesuatu berlaku kepada anda.
Runs the mob AABB precheck after this ma: Menjalankan prasemak AABB mob selepas bilangan mob dimuatkan ini. Sifar mematikannya.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Set up for your display. Leave on Auto unless it looks wrong.
Sets many options at once, as the pack g: Menetapkan banyak pilihan sekali gus, seperti yang dikumpulkan oleh pek.
Sets the options below together. Changin: Sets the options below together. Changing one makes it Custom.
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Sets the three below full screen, one test picture at a time.
Settings made by the pack's author: they: Tetapan yang dibuat oleh pengarang pek: ia hanya mengubah pek ini.
Shader packs, Horizon's and shaders/ fol: Pek shader, milik Horizon dan yang dalam folder shaders/, serta pilihannya.
Sharpens the upscaled picture. Higher: c: Menajamkan gambar yang ditingkatkan skalanya. Lebih tinggi: tepi lebih tajam, lebih berkelip.
Show the buttons for what you can do, wh: Tunjukkan butang untuk apa yang anda boleh lakukan, semasa anda bermain dengan pengawal.
Shows a made-up frame between each two r: Shows a made-up frame between each two real ones: smoother, a little more lag.
Shows only what you can do with what you: Hanya menunjukkan apa yang anda boleh lakukan dengan apa yang anda lihat, dan butang inventori utama.
Shows the buttons of the controller you': Menunjukkan butang pengawal yang anda gunakan.
Shows what your buttons do right now, in: Menunjukkan apa yang butang anda lakukan sekarang, semasa bermain dan dalam inventori.
Size of menus and the HUD.

Melangkau zarah di luar skrin, subpiksel dan tersembunyi oleh rupa bumi.
Skips terrain hidden behind closed secti: Skips terrain hidden behind closed sections. Off costs a lot.
Smaller copies of block textures for dis: Smaller copies of block textures for distant terrain: less shimmer.
Smooths jagged edges. FXAA: softer. TAA:: Smooths jagged edges. FXAA: softer. TAA: smoothest, moving things may trail.
Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk bui: Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk building time only.
Sorts water and glass more exactly behin: Sorts water and glass more exactly behind each other.
The USB vendor and product the system re: Vendor dan produk USB yang dilaporkan sistem. Berguna apabila melaporkan pengawal yang berkelakuan tidak elok.
The controller driving this player, or e: Pengawal yang memandu pemain ini, atau jika tidak yang pertama disambungkan.
The controller keeps playing while this: Pengawal terus berfungsi semasa tetingkap ini tidak fokus, dan kehilangan fokus tidak akan menjeda.
The controller the game sees, its button: Pengawal yang dilihat permainan, glyph butangnya dan maklum balasnya.
The display mode exclusive fullscreen us: Mod paparan yang digunakan oleh skrin penuh eksklusif. Dikenakan apabila anda keluar.
The glyph family the game picked from th: Keluarga glyph yang dipilih permainan daripada pengeluar pengawal.
The graphics device was lost: off until: Peranti grafik hilang: mati sehingga permulaan seterusnya.
The sky and weather, lighting, textures: The sky and weather, lighting, textures and the image.
These settings belong to this player's p: Tetapan ini milik profil pemain ini.
This feature is not yet available in Hor: Fitur ini belum lagi tersedia di Horizon.
Threads that generate, light and mesh ch: Threads that generate, light and mesh chunks. Next start.
Turn HDR on to use it.
Turn the view the other way, left and ri: Pusing pandangan ke arah lain, kiri dan kanan.
Turn the view the other way, up and down: Pusing pandangan ke arah lain, atas dan bawah.
Vanilla's own preset: sets only vanilla': Pratetap vanila sendiri: hanya menetapkan pilihan vanila, seperti yang Minecraft lakukan.
Vulkan, then DirectX 12 (Windows) or Ope: Vulkan, then DirectX 12 (Windows) or OpenGL (Linux) where it fails. Next start.
Waits for the display's refresh: no tear: Waits for the display's refresh: no tearing, a little latency.
Water and glass in one buffer: fewer dra: Water and glass in one buffer: fewer draw calls, a bit more VRAM. Next start.
What a DualSense's light shows, over USB: Apa yang ditunjukkan cahaya DualSense, melalui USB atau Bluetooth.
Whether a Nintendo controller's A and B: Sama ada A dan B pengawal Nintendo berfungsi mengikut kedudukannya atau hurufnya.
Which button does what. Each player has: Butang mana buat apa. Setiap pemain ada sendiri.
Which chunk rebuilds wait for the frame:: Which chunk rebuilds wait for the frame: none, nearby or yours.
Which on-screen keyboard opens when a te: Papan kekunci pada skrin mana yang dibuka apabila medan teks ditekan.
World pixels per screen pixel. Below 100: World pixels per screen pixel. Below 100% is faster on the GPU.
Your GPU or graphics API doesn't support: Your GPU or graphics API doesn't support it.

horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through horizon-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
horizon.extras.chat_animation.tooltip: A new chat line slides in from the left while it fades in, instead of appearing whole.
horizon.extras.chat_indicator.tooltip: The coloured bar at the left of a chat line.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx: Sembunyikan jejak dan aura pemain lain
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx.tooltip: Jejak dan aura pemain lain kekal tersembunyi; kosmetik mereka yang lain masih kelihatan. Mati secara lalai.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_mine.tooltip: Shows the cosmetics you wear on your own player, in third person and the inventory.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_others.tooltip: Shows the cosmetics other Horizon players wear. Off, the game never asks what they wear.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_solo.tooltip: Tunjukkan kosmetik anda dan lencana tanda nama anda dalam dunia pemain tunggal anda juga (tanda nama anda dengan Tanda nama sendiri). Mati: hanya pada pelayan.
horizon.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Shows Playing Horizon on your Discord profile while Discord runs: menus, single player or multiplayer, the dimension and the time played. Never a world's name or a server's address.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
horizon.extras.horizon_marks.tooltip: Tunjukkan logo Horizon di sebelah pemain Horizon: logo kecil sebelum nama pemain lain yang menggunakan Horizon, di atas kepala mereka dan dalam senarai pemain. Hanya pemain Horizon melihatnya: pelayan tidak menerima apa-apa.
horizon.extras.horizon_me.tooltip: Tunjukkan saya sebagai pemain Horizon: pemain Horizon lain melihat logo di sebelah nama anda. Hidup, perkhidmatan menjawab sesiapa yang bertanya tentang anda bahawa anda bermain Horizon dalam 3 jam terakhir; mati, ia tidak pernah melaporkan anda.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
horizon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Music & Sounds gets a Music... page: play any built-in track now, or turn one off so the game stops picking it. Nothing changes until you turn a track off.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, horizon-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
horizon.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Pilih Pek Sumber mendapat butang Tambah yang mencari Modrinth dan memasang pek ke dalam folder pek anda. Padam, permainan tidak pernah menghubungi Modrinth.
horizon.extras.pregen.tooltip: Membolehkan /pregen dalam dunia pemain tunggal dan LAN anda. Dengan cheat dihidupkan, guna /pregen start untuk menjana kawasan sebelum menerokainya. Tidak menghidupkan arahan itu pada pelayan yang anda sertai.
horizon.extras.repro_keys.tooltip: F3+R starts or stops a repro recording and F3+E writes its bundle. Off by default: a recording copies the world.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: In a world, another controller can join as a new player: press A when it asks, then pick a profile and where to play.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.
horizon.extras.wheel_cycles_list_setting: Roda tatal di atas butang dalam senarai tetapan menukar nilainya. Mati, seperti dalam vanila, roda menatal senarai.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Your invite code is ready: Game Menu, Play with Friends. Copy it and send it to your friends.
horizon.friends.finding_route: Finding how friends can reach you…
horizon.friends.hint: Friends paste the code after the title screen's Friends button, in Direct Connection, or on the launcher's Play page.
horizon.friends.relay_stopped: Terlalu banyak kod pendek yang salah, jadi geganti dimatikan sehingga anda berkongsi semula. Rakan masih boleh menyertai dengan kod penuh.
horizon.friends.share_intro: Share this world behind an invite code: it opens to LAN, and friends on the internet join with the code. No server of ours is involved.
horizon.friends.short_code_changed: Seseorang kerap mencuba kod yang salah, jadi ia ditukar.
horizon.friends.title: Main bersama kawan

horizon.mods.switch.restart: Mulakan semula permainan untuk menggunakan %s: ia menambah blok, item atau penjanaan dunia.
horizon.multiplayer.connected_friend_rel: Terhubung ke kawan anda melalui relay...
horizon.multiplayer.not_signed_in: Server ini dalam mode online. Log masuk dengan akaun Microsoft anda di launcher Horizon untuk bergabung.

horizon.pages.agent.tooltip: Let your own AI agent play: horizon-ctl and MCP clients on this computer.
horizon.pages.controller.tooltip: Controllers: their buttons, sticks, vibration and menu navigation.
horizon.pages.extras.tooltip: Optional additions, all off by default: the game stays vanilla until you turn one on.
horizon.pages.graphics.tooltip: Grafik, secara ringkas: setiap tetapan menunjukkan kosnya.
horizon.pages.graphics_advanced.tooltip: Setiap tetapan grafik, Horizon's included, with what each costs.
horizon.pages.mods.tooltip: Mods made for Horizon, from the horizon-mods folder. Each runs in a sandbox and stays off until you turn it on.
horizon.pages.music.empty: Tiada track musik: suara game tidak dimuatkan.
horizon.pages.music.tooltip: The built-in tracks, by situation: play one now, or turn any off so the game stops picking it.
horizon.pages.pvp.tooltip: Tetapan silang, HUD dan PvP, semuanya mati secara lalai. Tiada apa-apa di sini menunjukkan apa yang vanila tidak tunjukkan.
horizon.pages.settings.tooltip: Tetapan milik Horizon sendiri: grafik, controller, mod dan ekstra.
horizon.pages.shader_packs.tooltip: Shader packs from the shaderpacks folder: Horizon's own and those in the shaders/ format. One runs at a time.
horizon.pages.split_profiles.tooltip: Siapa bermain: profil disimpan di dalam folder game ini.
horizon.pages.split_setup.tooltip: The windows and monitors, and who plays where.
horizon.pages.studio.tooltip: Layari rakaman yang disimpan dan metadatanya.
horizon.plain.official: Horizon rasmi dengan pelancar, mod dan kemas kini: playhorizon.dev
horizon.pvp.chat_compact.tooltip: Mesej yang berulang berturut-turut ditunjukkan sekali, dengan berapa kali ia datang: (x3).
horizon.pvp.chat_copy.tooltip: Mengklik mesej dalam sembang terbuka menyalin teksnya, melainkan klik itu melakukan sesuatu yang lain.
horizon.pvp.chat_search.tooltip: Ctrl+F dalam sembang terbuka: apa yang anda taip hanya menunjukkan mesej yang mengandunginya. Enter atau Ctrl+F sekali lagi berhenti.
horizon.pvp.chat_timestamps.tooltip: Masa setiap mesej masuk, sebelum ia.
horizon.pvp.clear_lava.tooltip: Dalam lava, lihat sejauh yang Rintangan Api vanila benarkan, tanpa kesan itu.
horizon.pvp.clear_water.tooltip: Di bawah air, lihat sejauh yang vanila benarkan selepas 30 saat di situ, sejak awal.
horizon.pvp.combat_feel.tooltip: Legacy melukis pertarungan seperti 1.8.9: item di tangan anda, hayunannya, makan, busur dan pedang yang diangkat semasa anda menahan guna, tanpa penurunan selepas setiap hentaman atau penunjuk serangan. Rupa sahaja: apa yang anda hantar ke pelayan kekal sama.
horizon.pvp.combat_indicator.tooltip: Mengekalkan penunjuk serangan di bawah Legacy, yang tidak ada pada 1.8.9.
horizon.pvp.combat_rules: Pertempuran 1.8 dalam dunia yang anda hoskan
horizon.pvp.combat_rules.tooltip: Pemain tunggal dan dunia yang anda buka ke LAN bertarung mengikut peraturan 1.8.9: tiada cooldown serangan atau sapuan, kerosakan senjata 1.8, Kekuatan, Ketajaman dan hentaman kritikal. Pelayan yang anda sertai mengekalkan peraturan mereka sendiri.
horizon.pvp.combat_sounds.tooltip: Di bawah Legacy, meninggalkan bunyi serangan yang ditambah 1.9 (kuat, lemah, sapuan, kritikal...). Bunyi cedera kekal.
horizon.pvp.crosshair.tooltip: Melukis silang anda sendiri dan bukannya silang vanila. Tetapan pertamanya kelihatan seperti vanila.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_colour.tooltip: Songsang menunjukkan warna di bawahnya secara songsang, seperti silang vanila.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_hover.tooltip: Warna lain semasa silang berada di atas mob atau pemain yang boleh anda pukul, seperti yang diketahui oleh penunjuk serangan vanila.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_outline.tooltip: Tepi hitam nipis, supaya ia kelihatan pada mana-mana latar.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_shape.tooltip: Silang, T, X, bulatan, segi empat sama atau hanya titik.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_size.tooltip: Panjang setiap lengan, dalam piksel GUI.
horizon.pvp.editor.hint: Seret widget · Roda: saiz · Klik kanan: kembali ke sudutnya
horizon.pvp.editor.tooltip: Gerakkan widget pada permainan: seret ke mana-mana, ubah saiz dengan roda, klik kanan satu untuk meletakkannya kembali di sudutnya.

horizon.options.server_stick.tooltip: How the stick moves on a server. Java moves only by its keys, so a server's anticheat may pull you back for the stick's own speed and angle. Analog: as you push it (servers that do not check). Free Direction: any angle at full speed, by turning the look the server sees (others see your head follow; it turns back to your view for every hit, use and block). D-pad: arrows on screen in the stick's place (a controller's stick takes the nearest of their eight directions), at full speed. A server you picked a mode for when it pulled you back keeps that one; change this while playing there to change it.
horizon.options.stick_prompt.tooltip: When a server keeps pulling you back while the stick moves you, ask how the stick should move there.
starling.stick_prompt.title: This Server Pulls You Back
starling.stick_prompt.body: Its anticheat (Grim or one like it) takes only the moves Java's keys make, and the stick's own speed and angle are not one of them. Pick how the stick moves here; Options > Controls > Controller Settings changes it any time.
Sets distance, particles, shadows, sky a: Sets distance, particles, shadows, sky and fog; changing one makes it Custom.
Your display's darkest black. 0 for OLED: Your display's darkest black. 0 for OLED; LCDs glow a little.
How bright white paper and menus look. A: How bright white paper and menus look. Auto: your desktop's white.
How bright the HUD and menus are, agains: How bright the HUD and menus are, against paper white.
A key that opens this screen from the ga: A key that opens this screen from the game. Not bound at first.
